The Physiopedia charity is on a mission to improve global health by providing universal access to rehabilitation knowledge.  

We are the #1 Rehabilitation website in the world, and a UK registered charity.

Physiopedia is supported by Physiopedia Plus online professional development for rehabilitation https://members.physio-pedia.com

Plus members have access to hundreds of hours of accredited online courses, thousands of online resources as well as their own online portfolio plus much more...AND they support learners all over the globe through the Physiopedia charity.

Join us: https://members.physio-pedia.com/why-physioplus/
